messages:
tara: noticing users flapping between roles in our audit logs. looks like SCIM deprovision followed by immediate reprovision for same user twice in last hour.

omar: any commonalities (tenant, app)?

tara: corp-okta tenant, app `internal-console`. sample event id prov-31415. captured SAML assertion shows groups present then empty on refresh.

jin: sounds like idp session refresh + group-filtering. Okta recently pushed a claim filter for that tenant.

prov-bot: automated action: disabled `scim.deprov_immediate` for tenant corp-okta (requested by tara).

kms-ops: spotted surge of KMS decrypt errs for key alias projects/redwood/kms/keys/provisioner: 18 errors in last 2h, error=InvalidEncryptionContext. retry storms could cause duplicate reconciles.

omar: mitigation plan: 1) keep deprov disabled for 24h; 2) add short dedupe using ASSERTION_ID for 5m window; 3) emit audit event scim.policy.change when we change tenant flags; 4) open Okta ticket.

okta-support: INC-88120 opened. We will confirm whether group-filtering can be scoped to avoid refresh-truncation.

jin: follow-ups: jin -> add ASSERTION_ID idempotency, tara -> attach sample prov events to INC-88120, kms-ops -> investigate InvalidEncryptionContext spikes.

tara: leaving note for compliance: we flipped deprov_immediate for corp-okta; audit entry will be generated once policy change recorded. will update when Okta responds.
